Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
refactor(Sky): Extract debug and workspace relays into dedicated installers

Separate the debug lifecycle, custom-editor, and workspace/decoration logic from the monolithic `Bridge.ts` into `Source/Function/Sky/Bridge/InstallDebug.ts` (implicitly created via import) and the new `InstallTasksAndDecorations.ts` module.

The `InstallTasksAndDecorations` file encapsulates relays for task execution, workspace edits, window focus, and the 16ms-batched decoration create/dispose flow, implementing a demultiplexing strategy for batched payloads. It also consolidates the six-action output-channel lifecycle and webview message/dispose relays.

This continues the modularization effort initiated in previous commits, ensuring each domain of Mountain-to-Sky IPC (debug, tasks, workspace, UI decorations) resides in a self-contained installer. The `Bridge.ts` entry point now delegates these complex relays via dynamic imports, preserving the existing DOM event dispatch shapes (`cel:*`) while reducing the static dependency graph and improving navigability.

The refactoring adheres to the PascalCase directory hierarchy and isolates specific domain logic to facilitate future maintenance and tree-shaking.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
refactor(Sky): Modularize Bridge.ts into dedicated domain installers

Extract the monolithic `Source/Function/Sky/Bridge.ts` into a hierarchy of self-contained modules under `Source/Function/Sky/Bridge/`. This migration separates concerns by domain: commands, statusbar, editor/output, progress/terminal, and diagnostic probes now live in distinct files (`InstallCommands.ts`, `InstallStatusbar.ts`, `InstallEditorAndOutput.ts`, etc.) or grouped relays (`InstallSimpleRelays.ts`, `InstallFanOut.ts`).

The refactor utilizes dynamic imports to load these modules asynchronously, hydrating local symbols (e.g., `BuildOpenArg`, `ShowProgress`) with the factory results. This reduces the static dependency graph, improves tree-shaking, and isolates complex logic like `CelDispatchTracking` and `ApplyHtmlToWebview` into dedicated utilities.

Crucially, this structure preserves the exact runtime behavior of the `Register` loop while making the codebase navigable. The `InstallDeadChannelListeners` module specifically activates the nine previously dormant Mountain-to-Sky event channels (tree-view, configuration, security incidents), ensuring that backend state changes are faithfully propagated to the workbench without silent failures.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(Sky): Implement nine dormant Mountain event relays and update imports

Activate nine Tauri event channels previously emitted by Mountain but ignored by Sky, resolving silent failures in tree views, configuration refreshes, extension lifecycle notifications, security incidents, status bar updates, terminal process IDs, and debug session hooks.

The `Source/Function/Sky/Bridge.ts` file now registers listeners for `sky://task/terminate`, `sky://tree-view/create`, `sky://configuration/changed`, `sky://extensions/installed/uninstalled`, `sky://security/incident`, `sky://statusbar/create`, `sky://terminal/processId`, and `sky://debug/start/register`. These handlers dispatch corresponding DOM events to the Workbench layer or invoke specific services (Configuration, Notification, Statusbar) to ensure UI surfaces update correctly. A task termination handler is also added to close task panes upon completion.

Concurrently, update all import statements in `Source/Workbench` (Electron, Bundled, Mountain layouts) and `Source/Workbench/Electron/Polyfills.ts` to reflect the recent PascalCase directory migration, changing references from flat files like `SkyBridge` to `Sky/Bridge.js` and nested polyfill paths (e.g., `Process/Polyfill.js`).

This completes the integration audit of Mountain-to-Sky IPC, ensuring that backend state changes and extension triggers are faithfully propagated to the frontend workbench.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
refactor(Sky): Enforce PascalCase directory hierarchy for workbench modules

Apply the project's strict PascalCase naming convention to all workbench proxy, bootstrap, and bundled entry files under `Source/Workbench`. Refactor flat-file module paths into nested directory structures (e.g., `WindPreload.js` becomes `Wind/Preload.js`, `ExtensionChangeSubscriber.js` becomes `Extension/Change/Subscriber.js`).

Update all import statements in `Source/Workbench/BrowserProxy/Layout.astro`, `Source/Workbench/Electron/` files, and `Source/Workbench/Bundled/Electron/Entry.ts` to reflect the new directory layout. Additionally, adjust the `astro.config.ts` path resolution for the `TauriMainProcessService` output to match the refactored directory tree in the `@codeeditorland/output` package.

This change aligns the workbench integration layer with the recent filesystem migration in `Source/Function` and `Source/Workbench`, ensuring consistent navigability and adherence to CodeEditorLand architecture standards without altering runtime behavior.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
style(Sky): Refactor file structure to enforce PascalCase directory hierarchy

Rename all flat-file modules under `Source/Function` and `Source/Workbench` to nested directories that strictly adhere to the PascalCase naming convention required by the CodeEditorLand architecture. This structural migration transforms flat files like `BuildVSCode.ts` into `Build/VS/Code.ts` and `SkyBridge.ts` into `Sky/Bridge.ts`, ensuring consistent directory organization that mirrors the semantic hierarchy of the component names.

No logic, behavior, or code content has been altered; this is a pure refactoring of the filesystem layout. The change aligns the `Sky` element's source tree with the project's strict naming standards for modules and file paths, improving navigability and consistency across the codebase.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
style(Sky): Normalize spacing in conditional block for openView call

Reformat the multi-line condition check and function invocation for `Services.Views.openView` in SkyBridge. Align the closing brace of the `if` condition with the opening keyword and place the `catch` handler on a single line to match the project's consistent formatting style.

This change affects only whitespace and line breaks within the `Source/Function/SkyBridge.ts` file. It does not alter the logic, execution flow, or behavior of the view reopening mechanism, but ensures visual consistency with the surrounding codebase.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(Sky): Integrate real WebviewInput and implement pending HTML replay for race conditions

Replace the static placeholder implementation in SkyBridge with a conditional path that attempts to instantiate a real workbench `WebviewInput` via `IWebviewWorkbenchService.openWebview`. This enables actual iframe rendering and message-port plumbing, falling back to the placeholder only if the service chain is unavailable.

Address race conditions where extension code sets `view.webview.html` synchronously during `resolveWebviewView` before the resolver is fully registered or the panel becomes visible. Implement a global pending HTML cache (`__CEL_WEBVIEW_PENDING_HTML__`) keyed by ViewId and Handle. Upon successful resolver registration, replay any cached HTML using the correct `setHtml` method signature preferred by the workbench, rather than relying on property assignment which previously no-opped on real workbench objects.

Add a defensive `openView` trigger to force re-evaluation of the WebviewViewPane's visibility state if a resolver registers after the pane has already activated, ensuring the `onDidChangeBodyVisibility` event fires and the new resolver is utilized. Update diagnostic logging to report whether HTML was applied via method, setter, or replayed from cache.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(Sky): Add post-registration probe for WebviewView resolver map integrity

Insert a diagnostic probe immediately after `register` call to verify the workbench's `_resolvers` map actually contains the new `ViewId`. This addresses a specific failure mode where registration completes silently but the `resolve` callback never fires, indicating the `WebviewViews` service instance used by SkyBridge is disjoint from the instance used by `WebviewViewPane` due to a dependency injection scope mismatch.

The probe checks both `_resolvers` and `_awaitingRevival` maps, emitting a structured diagnostic log to Mountain via the IPC channel. This confirms whether the bridge is talking to the correct service instance or if a DI scope issue is preventing view revival. Logs include map sizes and resolution status to differentiate between registration failure and resolver isolation.

This complements the existing entry-trace logging by validating the internal state of the workbench immediately after registration, providing a deterministic signal to triage 'register-success-but-no-resolve' bugs during extension host hot-reloads.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(Sky): Add diagnostic tracing for WebviewView registration lifecycle

Introduce unconditional logging hooks in SkyBridge to expose the full lifecycle of the `webview/registerView` IPC event and the subsequent workbench `resolveWebviewView` callback. Add a one-time diagnostic emit on the first registration to verify payload shape, `ViewId` resolution, and `__CEL_SERVICES__` availability. Embed an entry trace at the start of the resolver callback to distinguish between workbench invocation failures and internal logic errors. Mirror all registration outcomes (including duplicate-guarded cases) to `Mountain.dev.log` via the diagnostic IPC to ensure visibility into the gRPC bridge chain even when the browser console is unavailable.

This change addresses opaque failures during extension host hot-reloads and startup by providing a deterministic file-sink trail for triaging WebviewView service registration issues, ensuring the bridge state is observable before the resolver logic executes.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(Sky): Enforce telemetry kill-switch and bridge event replay for bundled profiles

Extend the Sky bridge and bundled workbench entry points to honor the master `Capture` and `Report` environment variables, ensuring PostHog and OTLP telemetry can be globally disabled alongside the `Disable` polyfill kill-switch. Update `OTELBridge.ts` and `PostHogBridge.ts` to gate initialization on these flags and suppress built-in unhandled error capture to avoid duplicate null-property events.

Add the `sky:replay-events` invocation at the end of `InstallSkyBridge` for bundled profiles to drain pending Mountain events (tree-view registrations, SCM providers, terminal buffers) that occur during the Cocoon activation cascade, preventing event loss when listeners attach late. Update `SkyBridge.ts` to correctly handle `TauriChannel` method interception and search-result mapping shapes. Apply consistent PascalCase formatting and multiline brace styles across entry scripts, smoke tests, and Astro layouts to align with project standards.

This ensures robust event delivery during startup, accurate diagnostics via telemetry gates, and formatting consistency across the bundled editor profiles.
